title: About
text: About A foundation so every young person gets their chance Youthaid Academy is a social initiative dedicated to equal opportunities for young people from disadvantaged backgrounds. Why Youthaid Academy? Too many talented young people see their ambitions held back by a lack of network, information or support. Youthaid Academy was created to change that. We support young people facing difficulties towards academic, professional and entrepreneurial success by connecting them with mentors from many professional fields, and by offering them opportunities for training, jobs, internships, apprenticeships, student jobs and civic engagement in their local community and beyond. Connect young people with committed mentors Train through accessible online learning paths Open access to academic and professional opportunities Bring together a community of members, volunteers and partners Measure our impact transparently Our community Further, together Young people At the heart of everything we do: they build their path, we support them. Mentors Professionals and volunteers who pass on their experience. Volunteers and members They bring our actions, events and community to life. Partners Companies, institutions and associations that open doors. Want to know more? Discover our mission, vision and values. Mission and values

title: Mission, vision and values
text: Mission, vision and values Acting for equal opportunities What drives us, where we’re heading and how we get there. Our mission Support young people from disadvantaged backgrounds towards academic, professional and entrepreneurial success through mentoring, training and access to real opportunities. Our vision A world where social background no longer determines the future: every young person has access to the same networks, knowledge and chances. Our approach Personal support, backed by a secure digital platform connecting young people, mentors, volunteers and partners. Our values What we believe in Equal opportunities We act so that talent, not background, opens doors. Solidarity Success is built together, thanks to those who pass on what they know. Trust Data protection, approved matches, financial transparency. Commitment We encourage every young person to get involved in their community in turn.

title: Mentoring
text: Mentoring A mentor changes everything Mentoring is at the heart of Youthaid Academy: a volunteer professional supports a young person, listens, advises and opens up their network. Request a mentor Become a mentor How it works Structured support Your request You describe your needs, your project and your availability. The match We suggest a mentor based on clear criteria: field, goals, language, location. Approval Every pair is approved by a team coordinator. Follow-up Regular meetings, a progress log and an end-of-programme review. For young people A caring outside view, practical advice, a network that opens up and someone who believes in you. For mentors Pass on knowledge, give meaning to your experience and make a real contribution to equal opportunities. A safe framework Approved matches, a commitment charter and supervision by our coordinators.

title: FAQ
text: FAQ Frequently asked questions Can’t find your answer? Write to us. Who can benefit from Youthaid Academy? Young people, especially from disadvantaged backgrounds, who want support towards academic, professional or entrepreneurial success. Is mentoring paid for young people? Our mentors are volunteers. Access conditions for each programme are set out when you sign up. How is my mentor chosen? Based on your needs, project, availability and the mentor’s skills. Every match is approved by a coordinator. Do I need special skills to be a mentor? Mostly listening, kindness and a little time. Your professional experience, whatever it is, is valuable. When do the online courses open? The Youthaid Academy’s Compétences catalogue will open step by step. Sign up to be notified. How can I donate? Online giving is coming soon. In the meantime, contact us via the Contact page. How is my data protected? We only collect the data we need and never sell it. See our privacy policy for details. Is the site available in English? Yes! Use the EN / FR button at the top of every page. Ask a question

title: Privacy policy
text: Personal data Privacy policy Last updated: 19 November 2026 Youthaid Academy cares deeply about protecting your personal data, especially that of the young people we support. This policy explains what data we collect, why, and your rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Data collected Through the site’s forms (contact, membership, mentor, volunteer): name, email, city and any information you choose to share. Forms open your email app: data reaches us only through the email you send. Purposes Answering your requests; Processing memberships and applications (mentors, volunteers); Organising support and matches; Keeping you informed of our work, if you agreed. Legal basis Your consent and, for memberships, the performance of your relationship with the association. Recipients and retention Your data is only used by the Youthaid Academy team and is never sold. It is kept as long as needed to handle your request, then for at most 3 years after our last exchange. Minors For young people under 15, consent from a parent or legal guardian is required. Your rights You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object and port your data. To exercise them, email contact@youthaidacademy.org or use the Contact page . You may also contact the CNIL (cnil.fr). Cookies See our cookie policy .
